title: Quenched Irish Peanut Cake
description: A sweet, bouncy keto-friendly cake baked in a mason jar, finished with a lacquer‑glaze of peanut butter and coconut oil.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180C and line a 750ml mason jar with parchment paper.
Whisk almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, salt, and erythritol in a bowl.
Beat the egg with peanut oil, vanilla extract, and cinnamon until smooth.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared jar, leaving a small gap at the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from oven, let the cake cool for 5 minutes, then carefully spread the glaze made from peanut butter, coconut oil, powdered erythritol, and lemon zest over the top.
Refrigerate the jar for at least 30 minutes before serving to set the glaze.
